Module 07: Automated Textual Collation — Learning Objectives

By the end of this module, students will be able to:

  • Classify textual divergence into the four canonical variant categories: substitution, addition, omission, and transposition.
  • Execute a manual two-witness collation against a base text to establish baseline editorial competencies.
  • Configure and run the CollateX Python library using dynamic programming alignment algorithms (Gotoh) and customized tokenizers.
  • Interpret directed acyclic variant graphs and export alignment matrices into TEI XML parallel segmentation encoding.
  • Evaluate AI-assisted variant classification models to identify conjunctive errors without conflating stemmatic evidence with convergent scribal slips.
